title: Forward recursive aggregator systems and the forward Epstein-Zin recursive paradigm
summary: We introduce forward recursive aggregator systems in It{ô}-diffusion markets, bridging the theories of recursive utilities and of forward performance criteria. The resulting criteria are constructed forward in time and accommodate arbitrary or rolling horizons. We derive the associated HJB SPDE and sufficient conditions for consistency and admissibility. We also develop a convex duality theory based on state price densities and identify the density generated by the optimal wealth process.
